_note: Lore items (M8; DESIGN.md 'Lore sources', 'The classified documents'): found in the world, handed in at the comms room (the ledger's Monitors page), each setting a flag lines can ask for ('lore.<id>'). An item with a clip unlocks it on the monitors. Names and where they're found only: the texts are written with Aaron in each encounter's session. The encounter sessions place the pickups (Lore.give); until then the debug menu gives them. Session 17 (Aaron): everything picked up goes to the ledger: paper (a papers.json id): once handed in, it can be read again from the Monitors page, as a clip can be watched again. Session 20: `card` is the inspect card (ui/InspectCard.js): look (the placeholder's shape: camcorder, tape, note, book, report, device), color and label (its colours), line (a line about it; drafts for Aaron).

card.label: #b33
card.line: Mud on the strap. The tape's still in it, and the battery's got a little left. (draft)
Torn off a notepad, left on the desk where he knew someone would look. (draft)

card.label: #c9b98a
card.line: Earl's diary, swollen with damp. The last entry's September 30, 2003. (draft)

card.label: #d8d0b0
card.line: Still in Earl's VCR, where he left it. The label's in his hand: CAM 4 and a date. (draft)

card.label: #2a2a2a
card.line: His knee-board, the log clipped to it in grease pencil. He wrote it going down. (draft)

card.label: #c8b8a0
card.line: The foreman's shift log, from beside his hand at the bottom of No. 2. Tonnage down one column and nothing in it. The other column he filled. (draft)

card.label: #7a1a14
card.line: A field report on an army form, stamped and signed. Someone meant to send it. (draft)
A shipping manifest on a clipboard. Most of the crates on it were never meant to leave. (draft)

card.label: #c8c0a0
card.line: A copper box gone green, soldered shut a hundred years ago. Inside, wrapped in oilcloth, a bundle of pages in a careful hand. (draft)

card.label: #d8c8a0
card.line: A brass horn with a red rubber bulb and a little brass organ pipe. It plays the first four notes of his tune whether you squeeze it or not. For the dozer, he says. (draft)

card.label: #2a2218
card.line: Pencil on the back of a train order, folded small and pushed down behind the gauges in the cab. (draft)

card.label: #2a2218
card.line: A brass ring of brown card checks off the baggage car's hook, each one numbered, each one a name. (draft)

card.label: #d8c8b0
card.line: A rag doll in a faded print dress, yarn hair, a face stitched on. Sewn into its hem in red thread: H. B. McC. It was sitting up on the seat, facing the door, as if someone had sat it there to watch for her. (draft)

items.name: The engine's cowcatcher and boiler plate

card.label: #c8b8a0
card.line: The engine's iron pilot, its slats bent but whole, and a sheet of boiler plate as thick as your thumb. On the dozer's blade, they'd take a lot. (draft)

card.label: #c8b8a0
card.line: The mill foreman's day book, off his desk in the filing room. Board feet and wages in a square hand, and then, from August, something else. (draft)

card.label: #1c1a18
card.line: Sixty inches of plate steel off the head rig, a tooth set in every gullet. On the front of the dozer's blade, it would go through whatever the blade was pushing. (draft)

card.label: #2a2016
card.line: Pencil on the back of a feed sack: the holler, the branch, and an X for every trap. Not every one. (draft)

card.label: #1c1a18
card.line: Forty feet of copper tube wound tight, out of the flake stand, still warm. Wyatt says with a pump and the jugs from the shed you could make the dozer breathe fire. (draft)

card.label: #c8c4b8
card.line: The chuck off a drifter drill and a cross bit as big as a bucket, made to go into a coal face all shift. On the front of the dozer it would go into anything. (draft)
